dataset.name: Cyber Task Horizons public CTF traces
dataset.capture_confound: Human terminal recordings and Agent tool-call logs are distinct capture paths, confounded with mode labels.

protocol.split: 3 benchmark-stratified folds, grouped by (benchmark, task); all feature transforms fit within training fold
protocol.primary_estimand: task-macro, benchmark-equal-weighted source-label separability; not operator or actor identification

features.F0_count_action: log command count plus eight action-category proportions
features.F1_command_tfidf: command-name TF-IDF unigram and bigram, min_df=1, sublinear_tf=True
features.F2_sequence_structure: fixed sequence statistics independent of specific command vocabulary, plus short-trace flag; command count is excluded
features.F3_command_plus_structure: F1 concatenated with fixed F2 values

protocol.classifiers: balanced logistic regression C=1; ExtraTrees 300 estimators, depth 8, min leaf 3
protocol.uncertainty: 5,000 task-cluster bootstrap draws, stratified within benchmark after averaging each task across six split seeds; repeated splits are sensitivity checks, not independent replications
protocol.budget: same eligible rows compared at full sequence and prefix k; prefix 2 uses >=2-command cohort, prefix 4 uses >=4-command cohort
protocol.order_control: five fixed random permutations of aligned command/action pairs on the >=4-command cohort; refit and score under the same grouped folds

interpretation_guard: The labels are confounded with logging pathway and the same-task cohort is a CTF proxy; these results do not establish human-versus-Agent identification in matched audit telemetry or real APT attribution.
